name: Plate XXXI: The Tree of Life
description: The ten Sephiroth and twenty-two paths of the Otz Chiim, struck through by the Lightning Flash that descends from Kether to Malkuth. Struck in Citrinitas: the yellowing, the dawn of the solar light within the work. Degree of Adept, rank 111 of the folio. “SCIRE · AVDERE · VELLE · TACERE”: To know, to dare, to will, to keep silent.
